baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated night noun, the two imperatives, and the final adjective of duration.
baseline_models.mechanism: The partitive opening selects a real portion of darkness; prostration gives that portion a bodily low point, while praise-prayer extends through the duration marked as long.

activation_trace.role: Night as darkness supplies the bounded temporal field, and its repetition brackets the commanded work.
Humble bodily lowering supplies the decisive posture within that field.
Praise, prayer, and remembrance supply the continuing devotional activity after the lowered posture.
Long duration makes persistence, rather than a momentary gesture, part of the command.

changed_reading.before: Perform prostration and praise sometime at night.
changed_reading.after: Set apart a portion of actual darkness for bodily lowering and sustain worship through an extended nocturnal duration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered imperatives to prostrate and then glorify within a long night.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse couples two contrasting kinetics: the body bends and the gaze settles, then praise courses onward. Length turns the contrast into a repeatable nocturnal rhythm of arrest and movement.

activation_trace.role: Bending and lowering the head supply the downward, arresting movement.
A sustained lowered gaze supplies still attention rather than a merely instantaneous pose.
Swimming or coursing supplies the counter-movement by which praise travels through the night.
Extension supplies the span across which lowered attention and coursing praise can alternate.

changed_reading.before: The two imperatives name adjacent ritual actions.
changed_reading.after: The imperatives coordinate still, lowered attention with praise that keeps moving across an extended night.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Prostration to Him followed by the command to glorify Him at length.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prostration removes the worshipper's claim to elevation, while tasbih removes defect from what is attributed to God. The long night sustains this two-sided clearing of self-position and divine description.

activation_trace.role: Humble submission supplies the clearing of self-elevation.
Declaring free from defect supplies the clearing of corrupt attribution.
Extended duration makes both clearings a discipline rather than a single utterance.

changed_reading.before: Glorification is an honorific formula following prostration.
changed_reading.after: The night repeatedly lowers false self-elevation and clears false defect from speech and thought about God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence binds the self, feeds vulnerable others, directs the act Godward, rejects human repayment, and later names the whole as acknowledged striving. Night worship therefore continues the same nontransactional orientation after the social recipients disappear from view.

activation_trace.role: Voluntarily binding oneself supplies durable commitment rather than a passing impulse.
Giving food to another supplies the costly outward action whose orientation is being traced.
Direction and orientation supply the Godward vector shared by service and worship.
Action-repayment equivalence supplies the compensation explicitly refused from human recipients.
Work and earned effort gather the preceding acts into a sustained practical endeavor.
Humble prostration carries the same Godward orientation into private night.
Praise-prayer supplies the nocturnal continuation of the acknowledged striving.

structural_cues: Ayat 76:7-9 move from commitment through feeding to an explicit refusal of repayment; 76:22 calls the completed course striving, and 76:26 resumes commanded action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: self-binding, feeding, Godward direction, refused repayment, and acknowledged striving. Reader: the night command continues that same agency when no beneficiary is present. Alternative: the ethical portrait and the liturgical command may remain distinct scenes.

changed_reading.before: The ayah prescribes a private ritual interval separate from the surah's social action.
changed_reading.after: The private night is the unseen continuation of ethically costly, nontransactional striving directed to the same addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection, the garden's covering branch, and shade's night-darkness branch converge on enclosure. They activate the focus night as a provisional protected prayer-space: darkness covers the worshipper while prostration gives that cover a place-like center.

activation_trace.role: Deflecting harm by protection supplies the enclosing function.
Nightfall as covering supplies a direct branch bridge from garden to the focus darkness.
Night-darkness understood as shade supplies a second sheltering image.
The actual darkness of night anchors the converging cover-images in the focus ayah.
A place of prostration turns temporal cover into a provisional prayer-site.

structural_cues: Ayat 76:11-14 progress from being protected to garden and lowered shade before the focus later returns to literal night.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: protection plus two branch images that explicitly connect garden or shade with night-cover. Reader: the focus night can function proleptically as sheltered sacred space. Alternative: these are lexical echoes without a spatial claim about 76:26.

changed_reading.before: Night is chiefly a difficult duration in which worship must be maintained.
changed_reading.after: Night can also be the covering that makes a protected prayer-space, a provisional shelter entered through prostration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord gives a drink whose purity acts on another; later the worshipper performs tasbih, whose purification acts on attribution. The two directions form a reciprocal pattern: divine provision cleanses the recipient, and nocturnal speech clears defect from the recipient's account of the giver.

activation_trace.role: Giving drink to satisfy supplies the divine-to-human direction of the exchange.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply the giver's transformative function.
Purity that purifies another supplies an outwardly effective cleansing rather than a static quality.
Declaring God free from defect supplies the human-to-divine-descriptive direction.

structural_cues: The giver is named as their Lord in 76:21 and as your Lord in the imperative sequence of 76:24-25; the focus pronouns continue that addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an other-purifying drink from the Lord and tasbih as declaring free from defect. Reader: these are reciprocal directions in one purification relation. Alternative: reward imagery and commanded praise need not be causally paired.

changed_reading.before: Tasbih is a one-way verbal declaration made by the servant.
changed_reading.after: Tasbih answers a prior divine cleansing: the recipient is purified by provision and responds by purifying attribution through the night.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is delivered downward as recitation; the next imperative sequence culminates in the recipient lowering the body and sustaining praise. Prostration becomes a bodily answer shaped to the direction of the received discourse.

activation_trace.role: Sending down and delivering supply the incoming direction and completed arrival of revelation.
Reading and recitation supply the voiced material to which the following worship responds.
Bending and lowering supply the answering downward direction in the recipient's body.
Recited praise-prayer carries the response beyond posture into sustained voice.

structural_cues: The declaration of revelation in 76:23 is followed without a scene change by the imperative chain in 76:24-26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: delivered-down recitation followed by a command whose focus branch lowers the body. Reader: bodily descent is a fitted response to textual descent. Alternative: the repeated vertical direction may be rhetorical adjacency rather than a designed causal answer.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is an independent nightly worship schedule.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages embodied reception: what descends as recitation is answered by a descending body and praise sustained into night.

context_deltas.mechanism: Patience supplies self-holding under pressure; first daylight and the late-day period then flank the focus night. The long night is therefore not an isolated extra but the nocturnal implementation of endurance that completes a continuous temporal circuit.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from collapse supplies the force that sustains the temporal circuit.
The first part of daylight supplies one boundary of repeated remembrance.
The late-day period supplies the second daylight station leading into night.
Night supplies the third temporal field and closes the day-spanning sequence.
Long duration makes the nocturnal leg the concentrated exercise of endurance.

structural_cues: Ayat 76:24-26 run as one imperative sequence: endure, refuse corrupt obedience, remember at the day's edges, then prostrate and praise at night.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: patience plus first-day, late-day, and night markers in sequence. Reader: the long night operationalizes patience across the cycle. Alternative: the time expressions may prescribe separate observances without implying continuous coverage.

changed_reading.before: A discrete night period is added to morning and evening remembrance.
changed_reading.after: The long night completes a day-spanning discipline, making temporal continuity itself an enactment of patience under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The diagnosis immediately after the focus joins settled love to haste, abandonment, and a weighty future day. The deliberately long night works in the opposite temporal direction: it slows desire, keeps the deferred day in front of attention, and trains the capacity to bear weight rather than leave it behind.

activation_trace.role: Love fixed in the heart supplies the deep attachment that the night discipline counters.
Haste and bringing forward supply the short horizon opposed by prolonged worship.
Leaving something supplies the act of dropping the deferred consequence from concern.
A day's severe event supplies the deferred horizon that must remain present.
Weight opposed to lightness supplies the burden that long practice prepares one to bear.
Doing the work by night supplies a chosen present action with a non-immediate horizon.
Prolonged time supplies the practical opposite of haste.

structural_cues: The focus command is immediately followed in 76:27 by a causal diagnosis contrasting the immediate with a heavy day left behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: prolonged night followed by love of haste, abandonment, and a heavy future day. Reader: nocturnal length is counter-training for temporal desire and burden-bearing. Alternative: 76:27 may only contrast two groups without assigning a pedagogical function to duration in 76:26.

changed_reading.before: Length intensifies the quantity of nightly praise.
changed_reading.after: Length changes the worshipper's time-horizon, countering love of the immediate and rehearsing attention capable of bearing the deferred heavy day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The body is created, tightly bound, and cohered at its joints; the focus branch identifies the limbs and lasting mark of prostration. Night worship becomes the deliberate return of a gifted bodily structure to submission, potentially inscribing repeated response on that structure.

activation_trace.role: Bringing the creature into existence supplies the body's gifted origin.
Tightening a bond supplies the body's structural fastening.
Cohesive constitution and joined limbs specify what the fastening holds together.
Prostrating limbs and their mark supply the created structure's concrete answering action and possible trace.

structural_cues: The bodily assertion of 76:28 follows two ayat after the embodied command and includes the possibility of replacing those bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: creation, fastening, cohesive joints, and the focus inventory's prostrating limbs and mark. Reader: the made body answers its maker by redirecting its cohesion into voluntary submission. Alternative: 76:28 may function only as a warning of creative power, not as commentary on the worshipping body.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified worshipper performs a conventional bodily posture.
changed_reading.after: The created and cohered body returns its very joints to submission, with long repetition capable of leaving an embodied trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later invitation says a path is actively taken. Focus branches make that path paradoxically kinetic: bodily lowering advances it, while praise courses through the long night. Duration becomes traversable distance rather than only elapsed time.

activation_trace.role: Actively adopting or acquiring supplies the agency by which the route becomes one's practice.
An extended road that is traveled supplies the spatial model for the focus duration.
Downward bending supplies the paradoxical step by which progress occurs without horizontal travel.
Coursing motion supplies the onward movement of praise along the adopted route.
Undertaking action by night supplies the route's actual temporal terrain.

structural_cues: Ayah 76:29 calls the surah a reminder and offers taking a route to the same Lord named in the command sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: active adoption of an extended road plus focus branches of lowering and coursing. Reader: the night practice concretely enacts travel toward the Lord. Alternative: the route can denote the entire obedient life and need not privilege this nocturnal practice.

changed_reading.before: Long night measures how long the worshipper remains in place.
changed_reading.after: Long night is distance traveled: one advances along the adopted route by lowering the body and letting praise course onward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The tether branch is surprising because an adjective of duration ordinarily selects temporal length, not a rope. It remains anchored in the focus root for long and gains a mechanism from tasbih's room for movement and prostration's submission. Downstream prose should present this only as an exploratory image of bounded freedom, never as a lexical translation of the adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective for long, the command to prostrate to Him, and the motion-bearing branch of tasbih.

activation_trace.role: A long, loosened tether supplies extension that permits range while preserving attachment.
Room for going about supplies the free movement available within that extended range.
Submission supplies the fixed relation that keeps nocturnal movement Godward.

changed_reading.before: A long night is simply a large quantity of time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the night is an extended tethered range: praise can range widely while prostration preserves attachment and direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context word for a captive activates a non-dominant split mapping whose branch concerns night travel, far from the dominant confinement sense. It remains valid as packet-authorized activation and reconnects to the focus roots for night-work and coursing. Downstream prose must label it a split-root resonance from binding into nocturnal passage, not claim that the captive word means traveler.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats night, presents action undertaken in it, and gives tasbih a coursing branch.

activation_trace.role: Binding and confinement supply the dominant starting condition represented by the captive.
The non-dominant mapped branch of traveling by night supplies an unexpected passage out of static confinement.
Undertaking action at night anchors the split-root journey in the focus's explicit temporal field.
Coursing motion supplies the manner of the exploratory nocturnal passage.

changed_reading.before: The worshipper remains stationary through a long vigil.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the vigil becomes a night journey in which Godward motion emerges from the surah's image of binding.

strongest_changes: The long night becomes counter-training against attachment to the immediate and preparation to bear a deferred heavy day.
The descent of recitation is answered by bodily descent, turning the command into embodied reception rather than an isolated schedule.
Night worship continues the same Godward, nontransactional striving expressed earlier through commitment and feeding.
Morning, evening, and night form a continuous discipline in which nocturnal length operationalizes patience.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made duration do more than measure quantity: it became ethical continuity, shelter, reciprocal purification, resistance to haste, bodily response, and traversable path. The packet's split mappings also preserved a carefully contained movement from captivity to night journey that a dominant-root reading would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from revelation's descent to the body's descent is inferred from adjacency and directional fit rather than stated.
The shelter and reciprocal-purification models may be deliberate structural echoes or only productive branch analogies.
The split-root night-journey and tether images should remain explicitly exploratory and should not control a lexical rendering.
